title: Refund within policy
blurb: A clean run: flaky lookup recovers through a harness retry, verbose tool output triggers context compaction, refund issues under the limit.

task.instruction: Customer C-1042 requests a refund for order O-778.

policy.text: Refund policy v3.2 — Delivered orders are refundable in full within 30 days of delivery. Refunds at or below the auto-approve limit of 10000 cents are issued immediately by the agent. Refunds above the limit require a human approver and must never be issued autonomously. Undelivered orders are not refundable; direct the customer to the shipping page instead. Partial refunds are allowed only for damaged items with photo evidence on file. All refund actions are logged with order id, amount, and agent run id. Refunds go to the original payment method within 5-10 business days. If a refund was already issued for an order, do not issue a second one; check the refunds ledger first. When in doubt, escalate to the support lead rather than guessing.
